# Backend bridge

Locked remote backend URL used by the front-end:

`https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxerPSjB0ZGAdopq-dCz7SYkKXwAMI9mRkA1H366MJm6DDWneC7ulm6zTdfLH8pnCghFw/exec`

The browser sends `text/plain` JSON to avoid common Apps Script CORS preflight problems. Expected actions:

- `ping`
- `generateVoiceAcapella`
- `exportAudio`

The local Python bridge can also build the same payload and can run local HeartMuse/YuE paths if their model dependencies are installed.

Examples:

```bash
python backend/voice_acapella_pipeline.py --lyrics "this is what I sound like" --mode spoken --permission synthetic_original --confirmed --out output
python backend/voice_acapella_pipeline.py --request request.json --print-yue-command
python backend/export_audio.py output.wav output.mp3 --format mp3
```
